_note: Fee and time figures for each rail. Costs are in USD, times in seconds. 'live' is true only for rails the real transfer module can run today (burn on Arc from the agent wallet, Circle's Forwarding Service mints, so no destination gas). 'basis' is 'quoted' (read from a Circle API on 2026-11-20), 'documented' (a figure on a Circle docs page) or 'estimate' (not measured). Full sourcing, and what is verified versus inferred, is in server/app/chain/RAILS.md. Circle says never to hardcode fees: these are for the quote only, and the transfer module asks the fee API again just before it burns.

rails.description: Circle CCTP, Arc to Ethereum, Circle mints for you
rails.source: https://iris-api-sandbox.circle.com/v2/burn/USDC/fees/26/0?forward=true (forwardFee.med 0.057 to 0.060 USDC, protocol fee 0; plus about 0.01 Arc gas). Arc attests in about 0.5 s: https://developers.circle.com/cctp/concepts/finality-and-block-confirmations. Forward-and-mint time is an estimate.

fx.description: USDC to EURC through Circle StableFX on Arc
fx.source: StableFX is permissioned (API key from a Circle representative, https://developers.circle.com/stablefx), so no public fee is published. The 5 bps is an estimate; the quote in app/chain/fx.py is the ECB mid-rate plus this fee. Arc App Kit Swap charges a 2 bp provider fee: https://docs.arc.io/app-kit/concepts/swap-fees

reference_only.description: Circle Gateway unified balance: deposit on Arc, burn intent signed off-chain, minted on the destination. No transfer fee when Arc is source or destination; a flat burn fee, plus a forwarding fee if Circle mints.
reference_only.source: https://developers.circle.com/gateway/references/fees and https://developers.circle.com/crosschain-fees (Gateway USDC 0.5 bp, none on Arc routes). Not wired into the planner: needs a deposit first and a signed burn intent against the Gateway API, no cheaper than CCTP with forwarding on Arc routes.
